reviews.author: Angela Kristi
reviews.text: I took my truck in for a backup lights switch and for my radio . They fixed the backup lights switch, they changed out the starter switch mechanism and when I picked my truck up he said proudly that the radio and the cigarette lighter both work now. I got in and started driving down the street when I tried to turn on my radio, to my surprise it was exactly like it was when I took it in. And to add to my problems, my (keys in ignition/lights on)warning alarm now comes on when I open my driver door for no reason. Also now my door lock no longer works on the truck door. I called him immediately to ask about this "considering he told me that the radio was working now". Oh also the starter switch is so tight now it is hard to turn on. He said that I could bring it back on Monday, so I arrived there with my neighbor and drop it off, the owners wife took my keys and said she would call me. About 30 minutes later she called me saying everything is working. I went back and she insists that the warning alarm is supposed to go on when you open the door, and the stiffness of the switch is because it is a new switch (well, in new cars the ignition switches are not stiff) and my door locks well .. it wasn't like that when I took my truck in to them. One other thing. The woman that talked to me, jumped down my throat saying that "I hurt her technicians feelings and that I was rude for calling them and telling them that my radio didn't work as per his word." So my conclusion is **If you like your vehicle I could not in good conscience recommend this place. NOT GOOD

reviews.author: Elle Kipper
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing people and service! I had another place thrown in some tires and it ruined my alignment. Called and Angie got me in ASAP. Super nice lady. Took my car in around 830a and it was done by lunchtime. Notification by text with the invoice and all details. No surprises!!! They even washed and detailed my car for me. I had a small piece of bling on the trim that was falling off and they glued it back on. Beautiful!!!!! To top all of that fabulous stuff the price was wonderful!!! Go You must go You won't regret it! PS I am new to the area and do not know them personally. This is valid.

reviews.author: Dissonant Dani
reviews.text: My preferred car mechanic for more than 13 years now. They never fail to fix the issue and properly. Usually get everything done with in a day or two. Can't complain. Pricing is reasonable, and I feel like they're honest.

reviews.author: Josh. Holcomb
reviews.text: Hands down the most honest shop in the area. I took my truck here to have a few minor things repaired. A few days later they called me and let me know that due to a larger issue they discovered, they decided not to do any of the requested work because it would be a waste of money for me. They didn’t try to upsell, they didn’t charge me for anything. They were in the perfect position to take my money and not say anything about the serious issue that I was unaware of, but instead they turned down my money for my own benefit. I will be a customer for life now. All service prior to this has been fast and affordable, and the entire staff has always been very friendly

reviews.author: Ronnie McQueen
reviews.text: I drove from Sanford because my car's moonroof needed repairs. It was well worth the drive. They did an excellent job. They have a great reputation and a loyal customer base. They do it right.

reviews.author: Preston Perry
reviews.text: Amazing! My pregnant wife and two young boys were traveling and had to stay at hotel when we got a bad oil leak. Dropped car off at shop and they offered to take me back to our hotel so I could be with my family. Within an hour came back to hotel to pick me up to get my SUV and got our family back on the road. Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Graham Miller
reviews.text: We are a dumpster rental company serving the Asheboro area we entrust R&D to get us back on the road quickly!

reviews.author: jason sharpe
reviews.text: Very professional and friendly! Punctual with appointments. Did a great job on my front end alignment and had it done in under a hour. I will bring my business to them again! Thanks R&D!

reviews.author: mary underwood
reviews.text: They gave my husband a replacement vehicle while our son 's truck is in their shop. Yesterday he called Thomas Tire Automotive to let them know that after they worked on his truck that it stalled again. Tomas Tire Automotive told him if it breaks down again to just call a tow truck and being it in. R +D Automotive gave him a replacement vehicle and Thomas Tire Automotive gave him the run around.

reviews.author: Enrique Jones
reviews.text: The only reason they are getting even 1 star is because of the extremely nice lady in the office. The mechanics are full of themselves. Very arrogant ! How does a front end alignment turn into a $1200 bill without even 1 phone call to the customer? $250 is the legal limit with consent from a customer. Do not do business with them unless you want to get reminded how you are beneath them.

reviews.author: greentwin50
reviews.text: Awesome Service R&D perform excellent service on my 2004 Chevrolet Tahoe. I went in for an alignment and found out I needed tie rods. The professionalism of phone call to let me know the reason I was having the issues with my tahoe was awesome. But the greatest thing of all, I was able to get all the work done at very reasonable rate. Thanks R&D

reviews.author: jay nixon
reviews.text: Tried to use this business. Very nice at first but more questions you ask the more that niceness slowly starts leaving... Crazy from a prior shop owner, how current shop owners don't understand customer's perception(only their own)and as soon as it gets difficult for me to hand you mY money which btw that's why I'm calling you/coming to you is for a required service you provide only to leave and know that not only will I never use you but also vote against you in a conversation. Enjoy changing oil

reviews.author: Logan Stanley
reviews.text: I have used this business 4-5 times on both of my vehicles and I have been happy with what they have done and the price every time. They were always so fast, also the lady at the front is a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: Kayleigh Cecil
reviews.text: Just wanted to leave a review of my satisfaction with R&D - I had to have my car towed on Friday night after hitting something in the road. First thing Monday morning I recieved a call from Angie asking what had happened and letting me know she'd be in touch when they figured out what was wrong. I was called back a few hours later with the issue, and cost, and they had my car back to me in ship shape the next day!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Wright
reviews.text: I really appreciate the care R&D gives not only too my car but too me! When I call for an appointment Angie always calls me by name and knows me and my vehicle. And they don’t mind when I ask them questions.

reviews.author: Scott Creel
reviews.text: If you are looking for a great and honest place to work on your vehicle please give these guys a chance, i have known them for many years and they have been wonderful every single time i have needed them, much appreciated because it is hard to trust people now days, so if you need work please reach out to these guys they are GREAT!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Hannah Miller
reviews.text: Super nice people! They listen to you, get you in quick & even feed you breakfast :) Very reasonable with pricing & let you know what to expect before doing anything.

reviews.author: kbrich17
reviews.text: They have done good quality work for me and my family for years and they are very reasonable. I don't take my vehicle anywhere else. 5 star company and family!

reviews.author: Joy Rich
reviews.text: Great people who take great care of their customers. Highly recommend you take vehicles there if you want quality and trustworthy service.

reviews.author: Sandra James
reviews.text: Besides giving great service on my vehicle Julie has always made herself available to give me a ride to or from my residence. I would recommend R&D to anyone that needs auto service. Thank you all.

reviews.author: Todd H Wilson
reviews.text: You can tell when a business truly cares about their customers. I highly recommend you see Angie and her family expert technicians, honesty people.

reviews.author: Ronald Davis
reviews.text: Very friendly people ,clean site, explained work done and bill which was explained in full. Good place.

reviews.author: Gina Byrd
reviews.text: Excellent place to do business!! They are easy to work with and know what they are doing. I would not go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Kenneth Cagle
reviews.text: Very pleased with the front end alignment on my newly restored GTO! The shop was clean and in order.

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.text: Got my vehicle home and noticed their was a oil leak and had just had my oil changed. And whoever changed the oil forgot to tighten the drain plug.

reviews.author: K Marshall
reviews.text: Fixed my truck real quick and didn't even charge as much as they said it was going to be. I will go back there.
